central_question: What did TOPA actually establish after the APP deep-mechanics source was frozen, and what apparent strength is merely an artifact of searching JANUS with JANUS-like vocabulary?

what_is_strong: Freeze order is clean: the APP deep-mechanics synthesis blob existed unchanged before both TOPA runs.
The end-of-yesterday snapshot already contains counterparts for every tested relation family, including the stricter compound signatures.
The most specific older lanes are not merely generic words: exact Sign != Source appears in 7 yesterday JSONs, Two-Witnesses + Difference in 11, and Time + Memory/Provenance in 29.
A dedicated Eye In The Sky authority capsule already existed yesterday and explicitly named The Alan Parsons Project, the 1982 album, and the Sirius -> Eye In The Sky opening pair.
what_is_not_strong: The older matches are internal JANUS lineage, not independent external confirmations.
The vocabulary was intentionally derived from a JANUS-formalized music map, so a high overlap rate is partly expected inside a JANUS registry.
All eleven strict signatures surviving does not imply a hidden code; several signatures remain broad and match hundreds of documents.
The older Eye In The Sky capsule proves preexistence inside the registry, not that the artists encoded later JANUS methods or today's conversation.
No dark nodes at these two lexical sieves does not mean the graph is complete; it means these particular semantic operators are already common enough inside JANUS to connect.

most_interesting_old_direct_anchor.why: Unlike a generic semantic hit, this older file already points to the exact artist/album and the Sirius + Eye In The Sky pair while preserving observer/surveillance and ancient-symbol firewalls.

relation_to_current_find_the_difference_.supported: The APP deep-mechanics interpretation and older JANUS both repeatedly use stable reference versus changing layer, multiple witnesses, source/verdict separation, memory, and controlled difference.

why_another_internal_keyword_sieve_is_no: Two increasingly strict internal passes already found no dark nodes. Tightening lexical thresholds further risks optimizing the search until a preferred rarity appears. The epistemically stronger next move is to leave the internal graph and independently verify the concrete musicological and historical claims frozen before TOPA.
